1 Principal AI Engineer Your Tasks
 * Being part of SQUER means driving solutions in client projects and actively shaping SQUER with your knowledge.
 * Lead our clients in their AI adoption, develop their AI vision and target picture, and translate both into a concrete, prioritised transformation roadmap.
 * You will support several teams by solving complex challenges of both frontend and backend development.
 * You will be responsible for introducing or improving the AI-usage in the SDLC across the engineering teams of our clients and successfully deliver software solutions together.
 * You can communicate openly and are a team player.
 * You are actively involved in all phases of software development in an interdisciplinary manner and are happy to share your knowledge with your colleagues as a sparring partner and coach.
 * You are an active member of mostly agile SCRUM teams and spread SQUER culture with the aim of constant improvement.

 * Your experience and big-picture-thinking allows you to create solutions that generate a sustainable impact for our clients. 
 * You are a rolemodel in the usage of AI-powered tools (e.g., code assistants, LLM-based workflows) to amplify your productivity and quality and you are proficient in guiding teams in their AI adoption.
 * You have several years of experience within software architecture, cloud-native development and containerization (Docker or Kubernetes). You would like to deepen your knowledge in this field.
 * You have solid knowledge of frontend and backend development and relevant trends within this area excite you.
 * You have a hands-on mentality and are proficient in one or more programming languages in the Java ( Java, Kotlin, Scala, Clojure, ...), Javascript (Javascript, Typescript) or cloud-native environment (Rust, Go, ...).
 * You continuously improve the AI-adoption along the entire SDLC, resolve bottlenecks and feel passionate about enabling software teams in all their disciplines.
 * Trainings and development of your skills are highly important to you. Moreover, you enjoy passing on acquired knowledge.
 * You are fluent in English and German (written and spoken) in order to communicate in the best way possible with colleagues and partners.

Your Benefits

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * Be Part of a Thriving Team Culture: At SQUER, collaboration and connection are at the heart of what we do. Through open communication, shared successes, and meaningful team events - including our annual SQUER offsite - we cultivate a culture where everyone feels valued and inspired to grow together.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

 
We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 95.000 and € 105.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

Die Post Business Solutions liefert Leistungen zur Optimierung, Digitalisierung und Automatisieru... 1 Senior AI Engineer - Post Business Solutions GmbH (w/m/d) Senior AI Engineer - Post Business Solutions GmbH (w/m/d)Standort:  Wien, Wien, AT, 1230

Berufsfeld:  InformationstechnologieWho we are

 

Experience the best of both worlds: Our business unit, Post Business Solutions, operates as a strong B2B Digital Services Provider within the secure corporate environment of Österreichische Post AG. Post Business Solutions is Austria's leading provider of B2B solutions in the areas of digitization, automation, and outsourcing of business processes in information management. We leverage our position of strength, consistently expand our market position, and also expand into neighboring markets. We pursue a clear mission: We aim to elevate the entire usage and management cycle of our customers' information and documents to a completely new level of performance.

 

What we can offer you
 

 * A dynamic and innovative work environment
 * Opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies in AI, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure
 * Professional development and certification support
 * Flexible working hours and hybrid work options
 * A collaborative and inclusive team culture
 * Discounted holiday offers & various shopping benefits
 * Company health promotion & free bank99 employee Account

 

What you will work on

 

 * End-to-End AI Engineering: Design and develop production-grade AI services using C# and .NET, integrating them seamlessly into our B2B document and information service architectures.
 * Intelligent Automation: Implement Azure AI solutions and agentic workflows to automate multi-step business logic for our customers.
 * Architectural Leadership: Shape advanced RAG architectures and LLM orchestration strategies across hybrid (cloud + on-premise) environments.
 * Quality & Performance: Establish evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS, DocVQA) to ensure high-performance model output, security, and scalability.
 * Team Excellence: Guide developers through code reviews and mentorship while collaborating with stakeholders to translate business needs into technical roadmaps.

 

What you bring with you

 

 * Background: 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally within regulated industries (e.g., finance, public sector, or logistics).
 * AI Expertise: Proven track record in designing RAG architectures and agentic frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, Google Agent Development Kit), including familiarity with agents.md configurations and advanced prompting (e.g., CoT, Few-Shot, ReAct, and Prompt Chaining).
 * The .NET Stack: Expert-level C# and .NET skills, with hands-on experience in Docker, Kubernetes, and the Azure AI ecosystem.
 * Fluency in Python: Ability to work with data science notebooks, and leverage Python-based AI tooling.
 * Modern Protocols: Practical knowledge of standards like MCP and A2A communication patterns.
 * Model Knowledge: Experience deploying Open Source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral, or Gemma).
 * Education & Certs: A technical degree (BSc/MSc) and relevant Microsoft AI certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate).
 * Languages: Minimum German B1 level for internal collaboration and fluent English skills. 

 

The minimum salary for a full-time position is EUR 70,000 (gross annual salary all-in). However, we are of course willing to provide overpayment based on prior qualifications and experience!

jobs.description:
Developing solutions for the green future of the metal industry?

Primetals Technologies is a global plant manufacturer and service partner to the metals industry and offers a wide range of career opportunities. We are pioneers, in the heart of Linz, with an extraordinary passion to lead the metals industry towards decarbonization and digitalization, ... 1 Project Manager for ECO Solutions and Converter Steelmaking (m/f/*) 

WHAT ARE MY RESPONSIBILITIES?

Our department manages the execution of projects in the fields of ECO Solutions and Converter Steelmaking. We deliver excellent project management and take full ownership of projects - from contract award to project completion - with a strong focus on maximizing profitability and customer satisfaction. Our ECO Solutions portfolio provides technologies and services to reduce emissions across iron and steel production while improving energy efficiency. In Converter Steelmaking, we cover LD (BOF) and AOD converter plants, as well as the innovative SMELTER technology for significantly lower carbon emissions. As sustainable steel production becomes increasingly important, we are strengthening our team I&S PM ECO&CS (ECO Solutions & Converter Steelmaking) with a Project Manager to lead these projects with the following tasks:

 * You have full responsibility for the successful implementation of your projects.
 * You manage the project within the defined financial, quality and schedule targets.
 * You identify additional opportunities within ongoing projects. You negotiate with stakeholders on change requests and incorporate them into contracts.
 * You manage the project risks by identifying and assessing all risk factors using available risk assessment tools.
 * You continuously monitor the project status, identify discrepancies at an early stage, and initiate mitigation measures where necessary.
 * You work closely with your team, define targets, and delegate responsibilities and authority.
 * You ensure compliance with valid regulations, rules and standards.
 * You ensure efficient communication with all relevant stakeholders.
 * You drive the project closure and ensure that all relevant information is filed and available for future projects.

WHAT DO I NEED TO QUALIFY FOR THIS JOB?

 *  5+ years management experience of complex construction and plant building projects
 * Advanced knowledge of engineering and business-unit-related technologies to understand technical implications
 * Advanced knowledge of project management methods and tools, as well as knowledge of contract law and regulations relevant to project business
 * Work experience in international teams
 * Willingness to travel and site assignments
 * Advanced knowledge in English and German

Social Skills

 * Proactive, solution-oriented attitude
 * High integrity in dealing with others
 * Quality oriented and structured work approach
 * Strong leadership and communication skills
 * Distinctive conflict management skills
 * Intercultural skills

WHAT ELSE DO I NEED TO KNOW?

The minimum annual gross salary for this position under the collective agreement and assuming that all requirements are met is EUR 53.241,02 (F/00) bzw. EUR 62.243,30 (G/00). This could rise considerably, depending on qualifications and experience. Our Pioneers at Heart receive ongoing training in a wide range of areas through the "Metals Academy". In addition, we offer further benefits: From flexible working hours and home office options to free parking and discounted lunch menus. We also offer a voluntary sixth week of holiday from the age of 50.

HOW DO I APPLY?

If you are interested in this challenging and exciting position within an international environment, then submit your application online now:
